algorithm: {The algorithm calculates priority by first identifying bins with enough capacity for the item, then assigning higher priority to bins with capacity closest to the item size to minimize wasted space.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_bins = bins >= item
    if np.any(valid_bins):
        remaining_capacity = bins[valid_bins] - item
        priorities[valid_bins] = 1 / (1 + remaining_capacity)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    valid_bins = remaining_capacity >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priority_scores[valid_bins] = -remaining_capacity[valid_bins] + bins[valid_bins] * 1e-9
    return priority_scores
